major_0.name: The Fool
major_0.message: A new beginning approaches. Embrace the unknown with courage and optimism. It's time to take a leap of faith.

major_1.name: The Magician
major_1.message: You have all the necessary tools to achieve your goals. Manifest your will in the world.

major_2.name: The High Priestess
major_2.message: Listen to your intuition and trust your inner wisdom. Secrets may be revealed today.

major_3.name: The Empress
major_3.message: A day of abundance, creativity, and fertility. Take care of yourself and those around you.

major_4.name: The Emperor
major_4.message: Time to take the lead, establish order, and organize your projects with authority and structure.

major_5.name: The Hierophant
major_5.message: Seek wisdom in traditions. Learning and spiritual guidance will bring the answers you seek.

major_6.name: The Lovers
major_6.message: Deep connections and important choices mark the day. Follow the path that resonates with your heart.

major_7.name: The Chariot
major_7.message: Progress and victory are on the horizon. Stay focused, overcome obstacles, and take the reins of your life.

major_8.name: Strength
major_8.message: Use your inner strength, patience, and compassion to tame adversities, not brute force.

major_9.name: The Hermit
major_9.message: Time for introspection and reflection. Step away from external distractions to find your own light.

major_10.name: Wheel of Fortune
major_10.message: Changes are on the way. The cycle of life turns, bringing luck and new opportunities. Be open!

major_11.name: Justice
major_11.message: Things will balance out. Fair decisions and karmic consequences guide today's energies.

major_12.name: The Hanged Man
major_12.message: A necessary pause. Look at things from a new perspective. Sacrifices now will bring enlightenment later.

major_13.name: Death
major_13.message: End of one cycle and beginning of another. Let go of what no longer serves you to make room for the new.

major_14.name: Temperance
major_14.message: Balance and moderation are key today. Blend patience and harmony in your actions.

major_15.name: The Devil
major_15.message: Beware of attachments and toxic habits. Recognize the chains that bind you and find the key to free yourself.

major_16.name: The Tower
major_16.message: Unstable structures may crumble. Do not fear sudden revelations, as they clear the ground for truth.

major_17.name: The Star
major_17.message: Hope, inspiration, and renewal. Keep the faith, the universe is pouring blessings upon you.

major_18.name: The Moon
major_18.message: Illusions may cloud your judgment. Pay attention to your dreams and navigate carefully through confusing feelings.

major_19.name: The Sun
major_19.message: Clarity, joy, and vitality shine on your projects. It is a day of success and revealing your true essence.

major_20.name: Judgement
major_20.message: Time to awaken. You are being called to a higher purpose. Evaluate the past and move forward renewed.

major_21.name: The World
major_21.message: Successful conclusion of a journey! Celebrate your achievements and prepare to embrace the totality of life.
